row.evidence: signNow's SSO guide says 'You must have a Site License subscription with SignNow' and offers SAML or OIDC sign-in only; no SCIM endpoint appears in the help centre, the API reference index or the pricing app's feature text.
row.notes: New row. No SCIM: SAML/OIDC SSO needs a Site License (Contact Sales paywall); after SSO is on, the guide says access is controlled by adding or removing users in IdP groups, but no SCIM or JIT mechanics are documented. The pricing page is a JavaScript app that could not be read; the Business price ($8/user/month billed annually) comes from signNow's own llms.txt, while the help centre says paid plans (Business, Business Premium, Enterprise) have unlimited free seats and charge by signature invites, so per-user pricing is ambiguous. The REST API is sold separately ('not a part of a regular self-serve subscription package') and covers team invites, removal and admin grants. Okta's OIN app is SWA (password vaulting) only.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: SSO requires a Site License; Enterprise without a Site License hits the SSO paywall.

plans.name: Site License
plans.notes: Hybrid: unlimited web seats plus a shared API invite pool.

scim.notes: No SCIM documented: docs.signnow.com/llms.txt has no 'scim' entry; help-centre sitemap has no provisioning/SCIM article; the SSO guide covers SAML/OIDC only.

capabilities.notes: Team-scoped: invite to team, remove from team, list team members, grant admin.

okta.notes: OIN page (last updated Oct. 17 2018) marks only SWA; SAML and SCIM unchecked. signNow's own SSO guide uses a custom SAML/OIDC setup.

fallbacks.notes: SSO guide says users are onboarded and offboarded by IdP group membership after SSO is enabled, without describing the mechanism; manual invites by Workspace Admin otherwise.
